screenshots.name: busybox-vi
screenshots.caption: busybox vi editing a file on the screen console. The console understood the VT100 sequences vi sent: rows addressed directly, tildes, a status line and a cursor.
screenshots.shows: The console text starts at y=96 in 12x20 cells (scale 2); vi drew it with VT100 sequences, so these pixels exist only if the console understood them.

A "~" on row 2: vi addressed the row with ESC[3;1H.
The status line on the last row (33): "/" of "/tmp/v.txt".
The cursor: a line under row 1, column 10 (the last "e")

The printf string on row 14: magenta (35)
